defects.title: A proposer who set an advice deadline gets no bell/queue prompt to close advice once advice is in; the proposal page does prompt
steps: Oren creates a proposal with an advice deadline (the form's optional Advice Deadline field) and opens it for advice
Amara gives advice (advice gate met: rounds 1 of 1)
Oren opens the bell / dashboard queue (GET /api/v1/me/next-steps)
defects.observed: next-steps for Oren (200) lists no close_advice item for PROP-3E2DBB96, while the proposal detail offers him 'consent' with ready=true and the page shows 'Enough advice to move on' (client/src/lib/proposal-vocab.ts adviceClosePrompt fires whenever the gate is met). services/next_steps.py proposal_items only prompts when advice_deadline is None or past, so with a deadline 2026-11-08 the bell stays silent until then.
defects.expected: Per the pass brief, the bell prompts the proposer once advice is in or the deadline passes, consistent with the page; nothing tells Oren from the bell that advice is ready to close
defects.evidence: GET /api/v1/me/next-steps as qa-member-oren -> 200 (no close_advice for PROP-3E2DBB96); GET /api/v1/proposals/1c0b619b-861d-4107-822b-89da029bf777 allowed_next consent ready=true

notes: OBSERVATION (not filed): nothing in Amara's bell/queue asks for a test report on her own 'Tool shed key holders (uxqa-p2)' (Test, no report); services/next_steps.py proposal_items has no test-report item for anyone, only confirm_ratification for a non-author steward once a passed report exists. The stewards lane step (1) judges whether she knows a report is what it waits for.

CROSS-LANE HAZARD: qa-member-oren's bell lists probe fixtures (record_position: Probe consent table (uxqa-p2); confirm_ratification: Probe steward-written test (uxqa-p2)). If the stewards lane confirms 'Probe steward-written test' or records a position on 'Probe consent table', probe checks (1) and (2) start from a different state. The lane brief says to leave 'Probe consent table' alone; it should leave 'Probe steward-written test' alone too.

CROSS-LANE HAZARD: qa-steward-amara's bell lists probe fixtures (record_position: Probe consent table (uxqa-p2); confirm_ratification: Probe steward-written test (uxqa-p2)). If the stewards lane confirms 'Probe steward-written test' or records a position on 'Probe consent table', probe checks (1) and (2) start from a different state. The lane brief says to leave 'Probe consent table' alone; it should leave 'Probe steward-written test' alone too.

Bell noise for ordinary members: qa-new-rafi: record_position Probe consent table (uxqa-p2). Every OmniOne member who has not taken a position is asked to on 'Probe consent table'; a lane persona recording one there does not move it (Sol's objection stays open) but adds a position the probe will see.

Every fixture carries advice_deadline 2026-11-08 (the form's optional field), including Rafi's draft, so its proposer's bell has no close-advice item before that date even with advice in (see PB-BELL-CLOSE-ADVICE-DEADLINE); proposals Ines and Sol create through the form without a deadline will get the bell prompt once advice is in.
GET /api/v1/proposals/:id does not expose ratified_text (not in ProposalDetail); the probe checks the captured text through register-agreement, as planned.
qa-probe-tess: /auth/me reports a non-OmniOne membership as her primary (oldest) member; her OmniOne member id here comes from her proposals' proposer_member_id.
